screen.wateroptimisation.title: Water Optimisation
screen.wateroptimisation.description: Client-side visuals only. No gameplay, world, or server changes.
screen.wateroptimisation.warning: Changes apply when you select Done. Turn them off if anything looks wrong.
screen.wateroptimisation.renderer.vanill: Renderer: Vanilla. Experimental GPU geometry is available below.
screen.wateroptimisation.renderer.sodium: Renderer: Sodium. Sodium owns water geometry; fluid controls are inactive.
screen.wateroptimisation.advanced.title: Water Optimisation — Advanced
screen.wateroptimisation.advanced.descri: Safe controls reduce client work. The experimental GPU control can change water visuals.
screen.wateroptimisation.advanced.warnin: Flowing, waterlogged, overlay, and ambiguous shapes stay vanilla. Fewer faces may change underwater views. Sodium owns its fluid geometry.
